title: Worker Output Evidence Schema
description: Captures source-derived evidence about a worker's actual output files, compared against the worker's pre-spawn contract.

derivedExports.description: Named exports actually found in source files (module.exports, exports.X, or export keyword)

derivedRequires.description: require() or import paths actually found in source files

missingRequiredExports.description: Contract-required exports not found in source

shallowImplementationSignals.description: Detected shallow implementation signals: TODO, FIXME, stub, placeholder, empty functions, return null/{}

shallowSignalDefinitions.todoFIXME: Lines containing TODO or FIXME in behavioral code
shallowSignalDefinitions.placeholder: Lines containing placeholder or not implemented
shallowSignalDefinitions.stubReturn: return null or return {} as sole implementation
shallowSignalDefinitions.commentOnlyFunction: Function body with only comments, no executable code
shallowSignalDefinitions.constantsOnly: Module exporting only constants where behavior was required
shallowSignalDefinitions.belowMinLines: Source file below minimum line count threshold where behavior was required
shallowSignalDefinitions.hardcodedPassRunner: Scenario runner that always returns PASS without actual test execution
shallowSignalDefinitions.reportWithoutTranscript: Acceptance report generated without execution transcript
